title: C Caller
text: Integrate C code in Simulink, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Sample time} sets Sample period; {Function name} sets the name of function, {Port specification} sets the port properties table and {Available Functions} sets the list of available functions. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Function name
params.values: Name of function character vector | string scalar

params.name: Available Functions
params.values: List of available functions cell array
